popCulture.title: Theseus
popCulture.description: Driven from Athens, the founder-hero dies on Skyros — Lycomedes casts him into the abyss, and the exile becomes as famous as the Labyrinth.

popCulture.title: Lycomedes
popCulture.description: The Scyrian king who murdered his guest — Theseus' host and killer, remembered for the cliff that ends the Athenian cycle.

popCulture.title: Parallel Lives
popCulture.creator: Plutarch
popCulture.description: Plutarch's Life of Theseus keeps the Skyros death in the biographical canon — Menestheus' usurpation and the fall from the rock.
